competencyQuestions.text: Which active alerts are correlated with the incident?
What is the priority and severity level of this incident?
What is the current status of this incident (e.g., investigating, recovering)?
When was the incident detected, acknowledged, and opened?
Which IT services and business services are impacted by this incident?
Which configuration items are affected by the incident?
What is the estimated time to restore the affected service?
Does this incident originate from a specific change or deployment?
Which resolver group or on-call engineer is currently assigned to this incident?
Are any related incidents or recurring patterns associated with this case?
Should this incident be classified as a major incident based on severity and impact?
Are there any open workarounds, runbooks, or recovery plans for this affected service or configuration item?
Was the incident triggered by any active monitoring or automated control?
Which alerts require immediate triage from a specific priority level or detection source?
How did this incident affect service-level objectives (e.g., availability target)?
Is this incident being escalated to an external vendor, and how is it being tracked?
What options exist for isolating an affected configuration item to contain the issue?
